title: Weck Canning Jars 743 - Weck Mold Jars made of Transparent Glass - Eco-Friendly Canning Jar - Storage for Food with Air Tight Seal and Lid - 3/4 Liter Tall Jars Set - Set of 2 Jars
description:
About this item
Includes Set of 2 Weck Canning Jars 743 - 3/4 Liters
These wide mouth mold jars are made of thick, sturdy and durable glass that is heat resistant - safe for microwave and dishwasher use!
Having the lid, gaskets and jar as separate pieces does make it easier for pouring and washing. The small glass clamp clip and lid with rubber gasket gives a great air-tight seal.
These eco-friendly big glass jars are dishwasher and microwave safe which ensures food stays fresh and has a longer shelf life.
Multipurpose usage: for juices, pickled vegetables, canned fruits, jams, jellies, dried pulses, and spices!

reviews_5s:
Just the right size for my sourdough starter. The size is perfect and I like the straight, smooth sides for mixing and cleaning. The wooden lids are easy to remove when feeding and seal well. The straight sides make is easier to see how the starter is growing. I wish I had bought these before the other two sourdough crocks I purchased. These are the jars you want for your sourdough starter.I was going to send these jars back but I thought about it a couple of days. I'm trying to get away from plastic and this was a good opportunity. I can use them to store so much and they are a good size.Absolutely love these jars. They are great quality. I have broken two of them, but I dropped them really hard. I have dropped them other times and they did not break. Highly recommended I will be buying more all the time. Two of my friends have bought the same ones and they love them.I heard about these jars back when I first started trying sourdough. I thought that I would wait until I would see if I would even need them. I've always tried to make do with a repurposed jar - after all "just how different could it be" "A jar is a jar, right?" I finally broke down and got a pair of these jars....

If you are actively making sourdough on a regular basis - and especially if you are doing multiple loaves at one time, these actually are MUCH nicer to use than a re-purposed jar, or even another brand designed with sourdough newbies in mind. (this is easier to get your hand in)

I like the fact the this jar has straight sides - I can easily get all the "goo" out with a straight silicone spatula. If you have ever tried to scrape dried sourdough starter schmutz left after your rise is over out from under a curved rim of a jar, you'll understand. AND.. the mouth is big... bigger than my last jar. you can actually fit your hand in to wash the jar out. I always wash jars after every feed - this is nice to have two and I can just swap out.

It might look like it is super big, but that means there is plenty of room for a nice active "starter party" to happen in your jar. I like that the lid has options.... i can just set the glass lid on for on the counter, or add the seal if it's going to go in the fridge for any amount of "down-time."

If you are new to doing sourdough, and find that you are enjoying it - take the plunge and get a pair of theses jars. Treat them with respect and they will last you a lifetime.I love them , really think glassThese Weck jars are exactly what I was hoping for—sturdy, stylish, and super practical. I’ve been using them to store overnight oats and homemade yogurt, and the airtight seal really keeps everything fresh. Plus, they just look great in the fridge or on the counter.

The glass is thick and high quality, and I love that the lids are reusable with the metal clips and rubber seals—no plastic waste. They’re also easy to clean and dishwasher safe, which is a huge plus for me.

Definitely a step up from your average jar. If you’re into food storage that’s eco-friendly and aesthetically pleasing, this set is a win.I was reluctant to spend this much for years. I finally treated myself. I’m using for sourdough starter but I could find 50 uses for them.Good sized jars and the lids fit well.Great product and priceYou don't need a specially shaped rubber spatula to get at the contents. Also, these are very easy to clean.
reviews_1s:
This was the second order I made for these. The first order arrived fine. I ordered a second set and they arrived completely shattered in a taped up box with glass rattling around inside. These were clearly marked as a return and were sent out any way. Very disappointing. Returning.I’ve been looking forward to getting Weck jars and when I finally got mine, they were completely shattered in their box. I can’t even send them back in order to get a replacement because the glass is going through the flaps of the box. Extremely disappointed.Absolutely, not pleased. The rubber rings don't hold their shape and the snap pieces are not attached to the glass. I spend too much time aligning the rings and then aligning the lid and then trying to use the snaps to secure lid to jar without disrupting the rubber ring's shape.

Waste of time.One of my jars broke in the dishwasher (top tack) first time washing them 😭😢When package arrived one of the two jars was smashed to pieces. Package was taken to Staples for return to Amazon for replacement.Arrived broken! Packaging was not damaged!First the lid and the rubber gasket do not stay together, making it clumsy to use. Second, I set a knife down in it and it broke just sitting on the counter. Definitely not worth the cost.Most frustrating is the gasket, too flimsy to stay in place. The lids are kept on by 2 clips which are loose. The clips will get lost. Nice glass just pain to use.I purchased these on a recommendation. I find the hard to be awful. The seal does not stay in place, the inside lip is so jagged it cut my hand wide open. I would not recommend these to anyone.Bought to start my sourdough starter, 1 jar intact, 1 jar lid came chipped - with glass chard under clip. Would like lid replaced. Jars look sturdy otherwise.
